summary: Iteration 2: Tested new employee management feature (Dynasty 8). Backend: 18 new pytest cases covering PATCH /users/{id} (name/employee_number/role/is_active), self-target guards (400), RBAC (ansatt -> 403), deactivation revoking sessions + 403 from /auth/me with session wipe, POST /users/{id}/revoke-sessions, DELETE /users/{id}, sale.employee_name propagation on rename, and activity_log entries (user_updated/user_kicked/user_deleted). All 18 PASS. Frontend: nav 'Ansatte' visible for admin, /admin/employees lists users with role/status badges and action buttons; edit modal saves name+empnum+role (PATCH succeeds and list refreshes); kick triggers revoke-sessions and shows Norwegian success toast; all destructive buttons for the logged-in admin row are disabled. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PATCH /users/{id} accepts raw dict (no Pydantic model). Adding a UserUpdate model would give per-field validation + OpenAPI schema and reject unknown keys cleanly.
server.py is now ~660 lines; modularising auth/users/sales/exports into routers is overdue.

Auth: get_current_user wipes sessions on deactivation but does so on every request for deactivated users — fine, but consider a 401 vs 403 split (401 is more idiomatic once the session is dead; 403 conveys 'known user but disabled'). Current 403 is acceptable and matches spec.
Activity_log writes are not wrapped in try/except; an insert failure inside log_activity would bubble up as a 500 from the parent endpoint (carried over from iter-1).
test_credentials: Created via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md: admin@dynasty8.no (admin, user_test_admin01) + sara@dynasty8.no (ansatt, user_test_ansatt01). Tokens disposable; cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Temp users created/deleted per-test via pytest fixture (uses pymongo directly). All temp users + sessions cleaned up. Sara was renamed to 'Sara Hansen Test' during UI test (then her single session was kicked); user_test_* docs removed at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_dynasty8.py (22) + /app/backend/tests/test_employees.py (18). Set ADMIN_TOKEN/ANSATT_TOKEN env vars via mongosh snippet in /app/auth_testing.md, plus MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env. The employee tests rely on pymongo for fixtures (already in container). Admin endpoints: PATCH /api/users/{id}, POST /api/users/{id}/revoke-sessions, DELETE /api/users/{id}. Frontend page: /admin/employees, data-testids: nav-employees, user-row-<id>, edit-user-<id>, role-<id>, active-<id>, kick-<id>, delete-user-<id>, edit-user-name/empnum/role, save-user.
